description: Leed certified government buildings is a dataset listed in Ontario open data catalogue, an open data portal, published or maintained by Infrastructure. LEED-certification recognizes sustainability in buildings' design, construction and operation. [LEED]: Leadership in Energy & Environmental Design. Coverage: Ontario. The portal files it under the publisher Infrastructure. Its tags are Gouvernement, Government, Infrastructure and Transportation, Infrastructure et transport. The portal shows 2021-01-14 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ontario-portal.
